guards.guard: og-3: this skeleton has NO default reading; zero-evidence input must abstain
the rival readings differ in part of speech, so a wrong pick is a category error and not a shade of meaning
degree is never read off the form; it is read off the construction, and the constructions are mutually exclusive
multiple survivors are PRESERVED as attributed alternatives, never voted or defaulted
the classical restrictions on which bases admit an elative are not encoded; a resolved reading describes an occurrence and never licenses generating one
the disputed membership of sequence and otherness items is left open and is not decided by this table
method transfers, conclusions do not: one occurrence's resolved reading never projects to another occurrence of the same lexeme
